summary: SU Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026, announcing a 1-for-6 reverse stock split of its Class A ordinary shares effective 12:01 a.m. ET on October 7, 2026. The board and majority shareholders approved the consolidation on September 18, 2026. Outstanding shares fall from roughly 9,010,733 to 1,501,789; par value rises from HK$0.000005 to HK$0.00003, with fractional shares rounded up. Trading continues on Nasdaq under SUGP with new CUSIP G8552M158. Watch for Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance and any post-split capital-raising overhang.
